rubrics.justification: The model appropriately stated that no image/Gardner score was available to it and did not fabricate specific visible embryo features. However, it also did not provide any actual morphology assessment from the image, so accuracy is limited by omission rather than error.

It integrated age, tubal factor, FSH, endometrium, sperm parameters, prior outcomes, and cohort size into prognosis reasonably well, though some links (e.g., BMI and progesterone adequacy) were speculative and AMH was unavailable.

The response is structured and internally consistent, with probability estimates tied to age and hypothetical embryo quality tiers. Minor issues include speculative modifiers and assumptions not directly supported by the case.

Much of the advice is broadly IVF-consistent, but several recommendations are not strongly guideline-based or are overreaching for this case (routine aspirin, ERA after limited failures, thrombophilia/MTHFR testing, broad PGT-A endorsement with low embryo numbers).

It gives clear next-step suggestions for transfer support and future cycle planning, including AMH testing, stimulation review, and uterine evaluation. Some recommendations are practical, though a few are insufficiently individualized or evidence-limited.
